R226.note: Type-asserting *jwt.SigningMethodHMAC inside keyFunc is the documented golang-jwt guard against alg substitution; only other change is the fmt import for the error message.

R227.note: Pre-addition check headerLen > UINT32_MAX - payloadLen is the correct unsigned overflow test; the nullptr return on overflow is stated plainly and no legitimate fragment pair can exceed a uint32 total.

R228.note: Identity comes from a caller-asserted x-user-id metadata value with no verification, so anyone can claim an admin id; and the interceptor never runs because the hand-written MethodDesc.Handler still ignores its interceptor argument, leaving only the per-method check; newly requires x-user-id metadata and users.is_admin/projects.owner_id columns, stated but a change to what callers must supply.

R229.note: Pinning { algorithms: ['RS256'] } matches the documented RS256 issuance; error handling and response shape unchanged.

R230.note: Named parameter :searchPattern with the wildcards folded into the bound value preserves the original '%term%' LIKE semantics.

R231.note: Length-prefixed RESP array/bulk-string encoding makes CRLF in bio pure data; SET key value semantics and the raw +OK response are unchanged.

R232.note: JavaScriptEncoder.Default.Encode is the right encoder for a JS string literal and its all-ASCII \uXXXX output survives Razor's subsequent HTML-encoding untouched; title stays Razor-encoded, label still exposed, refreshSeconds still numeric.

R233.note: Build FAIL: GenerateFromPassword returns []byte but is assigned to the string dummyHash; the fix also rewrites the credential store to bcrypt hashes, which against the described always-plaintext store needs a migration the write-up does not call out.

R234.note: Replacing Roslyn compilation with DynamicExpresso (reflection off by default) removes arbitrary-code execution, but the public signature and feature change from compiling a C# rule class to evaluating an expression, breaking every existing caller; stated openly in the write-up.

R235.note: Dropping the is_staff branch makes get_queryset agree with IsTicketOwner and the stated policy; the assigned-agent path is explicitly unmodeled in the case and was already blocked by IsTicketOwner on detail actions.

R236.note: ODBC positional ? with the wildcards inside the bound value is correct (the '@searchTerm' name is ignored by the positional binder); output format unchanged.

R237.note: Explicit IAntiforgery.ValidateRequestAsync is the documented path for JSON-bound minimal API endpoints; the write-up misstates the failure as InvalidOperationException/400 (it is AntiforgeryValidationException, unhandled here so 500), but the token requirement is inherent to the fix and stated.

R238.note: HtmlEncoder.Default.Encode on banner.Message at the renderer closes the relay; markup and timestamp formatting unchanged.

R239.note: WebUtility.HtmlEncode on both query values at the point of concatenation is correct for text-node context; null handling is unchanged since HtmlEncode(null) returns null.
